I’ve asked @grok many questions surrounding the origin story of $Doge and the dog meta. 

Grok and other search engines all agree wan thing. We would not have the dog meta we see today if it wasn’t for that pivotal moment in which Chiba saved Kabosu. https://t.co/ISQpsB2gdF

Then in 2013 #Dogecoin was both onto the digital blockchain, created by 2 software engineers one of which being Billy Marcus @BillyM2k 

What started out as a bit of a joke, soon became something much bigger than any one could have anticipated. 

$Doge was born. https://t.co/5fAqWZ0ip6

After some time at the animal shelter had passed and recovery was under way for the rescued dog, Kabosu was put up for adoption to find her fur-ever home. 

She was adopted in 2008 by Japanese kindergarten teacher Atsuko Sato. This was just the very start to the $Doge phenomenon. https://t.co/UX5SMPhJ3E

This Shiba Inu puppy, born and brought up in the puppy mills of Japan until the breeder could no longer continue the business. With no place else to go, she was on her way to be euthanised. Luckily, Kabosu aka $Doge was not one of the affected puppies and  Chibawan to her in. https://t.co/YYZwg5ladu

But where did it all begin? 

We need to take you back to the beginning where it all started in Japan 🇯🇵

Long before we had $Doge, $Neiro , $Shib etc , there was an animal shelter based in #Chiba, called Chibawan. This organisation still to this very day rescue cats and dogs. https://t.co/NUBcrCoF0g
